title: Trust and ethical considerations in a multi-modal, explainable AI-driven chatbot tutoring system: The case of collaboratively solving Rubik’s Cube
reasoning: The paper focuses on the integration of trust and ethics into an AI tutoring system, specifically targeting privacy, fairness, and abusive language detection. It also proposes a methodology (CausalRating) for evaluating social biases like gender and race in sentiment analysis components, making ethics a central research theme rather than a peripheral section.
